author: Steff Price
content: We couldn't be happier with the excellent service and equipment we hired from Dancing Cubs for our son's 3rd birthday party in our local park. We hired the Step2 rollercoaster which was a huge hit with all the kids! It was delivered and setup without any problem at all, then collected at the end of the day. Communication was excellent throughout! This is  a wonderful way of bringing something special and different to a little one's party - and hiring is much better for the environment than buying new. I would highly recommend Dancing Cubs and will definitely be using them again!
